"""Browser regressions using real DadRadar markup, styles and source.
All imagery is embedded locally; no family data, keys or provider calls are used.
Run after npm ci / npm run build:browser, with Python Playwright installed.
"""
import re,json,base64,mimetypes
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import argparse
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--output', default='/tmp/dad-radar-map-proof')
parser.add_argument('--executable')
parser.add_argument('--skip-layouts',action='store_true')
args=parser.parse_args()
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out=Path(args.output);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def asset(url,base=root):
 if url.startswith(('data:','#','http')):return url
 p=(root/url.lstrip('/') if url.startswith('/') else base/url).resolve()
 p=Path(str(p).split('?')[0])
 if not p.is_file():return url
 mime=mimetypes.guess_type(p.name)[0] or 'application/octet-stream'
 return 'data:'+mime+';base64,'+base64.b64encode(p.read_bytes()).decode()
def css(path):
 p=root/path
 return re.sub(r'url\(\s*[\"\']?([^\"\')\s]+)[\"\']?\s*\)',lambda m:'url("'+asset(m[1],p.parent)+'")',p.read_text())
def html(full=False,compact=False):
 s=(root/('Mobile/index.html' if compact else 'index.html')).read_text()
 s=re.sub(r'<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?</script>','',s)
 s=re.sub(r'<link\b[^>]*>','',s)
 s=re.sub(r'(src|href)="(\./assets/[^\"]+)"',lambda m:m[1]+'="'+asset(m[2])+'"',s)
 if full:s=s.replace('<html lang="en">','<html lang="en" data-family-full>')
 styles=['UI/map.css','assets/ui/airport-placard-enamel-v10.css','Mobile/mobile.css','Mobile/layout.css'] if compact else ['UI/styles.css','UI/map.css','UI/layout-side-rail.css','UI/sequence-history.css']+(['Mobile/layout.css'] if full else [])
 styles+=['UI/map-roll-transition.css']
 return s.replace('</head>','<link data-dad-radar-map-roll><link data-dad-radar-sequence-history>'+''.join('<style>'+css(p)+'</style>' for p in styles)+'</head>')
def source(compact=False):
 if compact:
  h=(root/'Mobile/index.html').read_text();files=re.findall(r'<script[^>]+src="([^"?]+)',h);files=[f.lstrip('/') for f in files if f not in ['/Mobile/layout.js','/Mobile/family-auth.js','/App/route-map.js']]
  s='\n'.join((root/f).read_text() for f in files)
 else:
  b=(root/'scripts/build-browser.js').read_text();files=re.findall(r'"([^"]+\.js)"',b.split('const browserSources = [')[1].split('];')[0]);s='\n'.join((root/f).read_text() for f in files)
 s+='\n(function(){\n'+(root/'App/route-map.js').read_text()+'\n})();\n'
 if compact:s+='\n'+(root/'App/map-roll-audio.js').read_text()
 s+='\n'+(root/'App/map-roll-transition.js').read_text()
 return s

GEOMETRY = """() => {
 const shell=document.querySelector('.route-map-shell');
 const rect=e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return {x:r.x,y:r.y,w:r.width,h:r.height};};
 const hardware=[...document.querySelectorAll('.clock-block,.eta-block,.sequence-mileage-badge')];
 return {shell:rect(shell), info:document.querySelector('.map-information')?rect(document.querySelector('.map-information')):null,
  hardware:hardware.map(e=>({kind:e.className,rect:rect(e),shadow:getComputedStyle(e).boxShadow,
    mount:getComputedStyle(e,'::before').content,opacity:getComputedStyle(e).opacity})),
  text:[...document.querySelectorAll('.clock-block *, .eta-block *, .sequence-mileage-badge *')].map(e=>({
    text:e.textContent.trim(),scroll:e.scrollWidth,client:e.clientWidth})),
  horizontalOverflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth+1};
}"""
AUDIO = """() => {
 window.cues=[];
 function cue(name){const s=document.querySelector('.route-map-shell');window.cues.push({name,time:performance.now(),
   moving:s.matches('.map-roll-to-surface,.map-roll-to-regional'),
   map:getComputedStyle(s.querySelector('.route-map-svg')).transform,
   surface:s.querySelector('.airport-surface-layer')?getComputedStyle(s.querySelector('.airport-surface-layer')).transform:'none'});}
 window.dadRadarMapRollAudio={createController:()=>({unlock(){},playMotor(){cue('motor');},stopMotor(){},cancelRegistration(){},
   playRegisterClack(){cue('register');},playDetentClack(){cue('detent');}})};
}"""
SURFACE = """() => {
 const shell=document.querySelector('.route-map-shell');
 window.surfaceController=dadRadarAirportSurface.createController({document,shell,now:Date.now,
 lookup:code=>({code,latitude:42,longitude:-87.9}),
 load:(code,done)=>done(null,{map:{code,fetchedAt:'fixture',features:[
 {kind:'runway',width:50,points:[[-87.92,41.99],[-87.88,42.01]]},
 {kind:'taxiway',width:20,points:[[-87.92,41.992],[-87.89,42.005]]},
 {kind:'terminal',closed:true,points:[[-87.901,42],[-87.899,42],[-87.899,42.003],[-87.901,42.003]]}
 ]}})});
 window.surfaceState={eventId:'fixture',flight:{number:'TEST',origin:'ORD',destination:'AVL',surfacePosition:{
  latitude:42,longitude:-87.9,onGround:true,source:'adsb_lol',recordedAt:new Date().toISOString(),heading:80}}};
 surfaceController.render(surfaceState);
}"""
results=[]
with sync_playwright() as p:
 options={'headless':True,'args':['--no-sandbox']}
 if args.executable:options['executable_path']=args.executable
 browser=p.chromium.launch(**options)
 # Actual desktop/full-family layout rules, including the compact entry point.
 for name,full,compact,w,h in [
  ('desktop-1920',False,False,1920,1080),('desktop-1366',False,False,1366,768),
  ('family-landscape',True,False,1024,768),('family-portrait',True,False,768,1024),
  ('phone-390',False,True,390,844),('phone-320',False,True,320,568),
  ('phone-landscape',False,True,844,390),('phone-forced-full',True,False,390,844)]:
  if args.skip_layouts:continue
  print('layout:',name,flush=True)
  page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':w,'height':h});errors=[]
  page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
  page.set_content(html(full,compact))
  page.evaluate("""() => {window.fetch=async()=>({ok:false,json:async()=>({ok:false}),text:async()=>''});
   window.XMLHttpRequest=class {open(){} send(){setTimeout(()=>this.onerror&&this.onerror(),0);}};}""")
  page.add_script_tag(content=source(compact))
  if full or compact:
   layout=(root/'Mobile/layout.js').read_text()
   layout=layout.replace("var full = location.pathname.replace(/\\/$/, '') === '/mobile/full';",'var full = '+str(full).lower()+';')
   # Inline fixtures cannot navigate. Only fix the selected test layout; the
   # production fit() and resize/mount code execute without modification.
   layout=layout.replace('if (route()) return;',"choice='"+('full' if full else 'compact')+"';")
   if full:
    # Avoid depending on escaping conventions in the source pathname regex.
    layout=re.sub(r'var full = [^;]+;', 'var full = true;',layout,count=1)
   page.add_script_tag(content=layout)
  if not compact:page.evaluate("""() => {document.querySelector('#dashboard').hidden=false;document.querySelector('#startup-screen').hidden=true;}""")
  page.evaluate("setDadRadarMode('EN_ROUTE')")
  page.wait_for_timeout(400)
  if not compact:
   page.evaluate("""() => {document.querySelector('#clock-value').textContent='11:59:58 PM';
    document.querySelector('#eta-value').textContent='11:59 PM';
    document.querySelector('.sequence-mileage-value').textContent='12,345 NM';
    document.querySelector('.sequence-mileage-detail').textContent='12 LEGS · 10 COMPLETE · 2 EST';}""")
  data=page.evaluate(GEOMETRY)
  assert not errors,(name,errors)
  assert not data['horizontalOverflow'],(name,'page overflow')
  for text in data['text']:assert text['scroll']<=text['client']+1,(name,'clipped text',text)
  hardware=data['hardware']
  for item in hardware:
   assert item['mount']!='none' and item['shadow']!='none',(name,'missing mechanical attachment',item)
   assert float(item['opacity'])==1,(name,'translucent housing')
   a=item['rect'];sr=data['shell']
   assert a['x']>=sr['x'] and a['x']+a['w']<=sr['x']+sr['w']+1,(name,'housing out of aperture')
  for i,a in enumerate(hardware):
   for b in hardware[i+1:]:
    ar,br=a['rect'],b['rect']
    assert ar['x']+ar['w']<=br['x'] or br['x']+br['w']<=ar['x'],(name,'overlapping housings')
  if data['info']:
   assert abs(data['info']['x']-data['shell']['x']-1)<1,(name,'inset hardware layer')
   assert abs(data['info']['w']-data['shell']['w']+2)<1,(name,'inset hardware width')
  page.locator('.route-map-shell').screenshot(path=str(out/(name+'-map.png')))
  results.append({'case':name,'geometry':data})
  page.close()

 def physics_page(reduced=False):
  page=browser.new_page(viewport={'width':1366,'height':768},reduced_motion='reduce' if reduced else 'no-preference')
  page.set_content(html())
  page.evaluate("""() => {document.querySelector('#dashboard').hidden=false;document.querySelector('#startup-screen').hidden=true;}""")
  page.evaluate(AUDIO)
  page.add_script_tag(content=(root/'App/sequence-history-display.js').read_text())
  page.add_script_tag(content=(root/'App/airport-surface-map.js').read_text())
  page.add_script_tag(content=(root/'App/map-roll-transition.js').read_text())
  return page

 print('transport: both directions',flush=True)

   const r=a.getBoundingClientRect(),s=b.getBoundingClientRect();return {gap:s.top-r.bottom,
    regionalVisibility:getComputedStyle(a).visibility,surfaceDisplay:getComputedStyle(b).display};}""")

  assert page.evaluate(GEOMETRY)['hardware']==before,('moving hardware',pct)
  if pct in [39,88,97]:page.locator('.route-map-shell').screenshot(path=str(out/f'roll-up-{pct}.png'))
 # Repeated live visibility writes may queue a target, never hide the rolling sheet.

 page.wait_for_timeout(20)

 print("first register:",page.evaluate("cues"),flush=True)

 assert page.locator('.is-surface-registered').count()==1

 # Reverse transport, with a resize during the roll.
 page.evaluate("document.querySelector('.airport-surface-layer').hidden=true")
 page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('.map-roll-to-regional')")
 page.set_viewport_size({'width':1024,'height':768})
 page.wait_for_timeout(30)
 page.evaluate("""() => {window.rollAnimations=document.getAnimations().filter(a=>(a.animationName||'').startsWith('map-roll-'));rollAnimations.forEach(a=>{a.pause();a.currentTime=1400;});}""")
 page.locator('.route-map-shell').screenshot(path=str(out/'roll-down-resized.png'))

 assert page.locator('.airport-surface-layer').evaluate('(e)=>e.hidden')
 assert page.locator('.route-map-svg').evaluate('(e)=>getComputedStyle(e).transform')=='none'

 print('transport: diagnostic',flush=True)
